in_sanskrit.name: Chanchal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Delicate, Trembling
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Chanchal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। From the Sanskrit root ‘chanch’ meaning ‘to tremble’, ‘Chanchal’ is a delicate and graceful name for a girl. In Hindu mythology, Chanchal is the name of a celestial damsel who is a companion of Lord Indra, the god of rain.

in_hindi.name: चंचल
in_hindi.long_meaning: Motionless, still, tranquil, calm, beautiful, charming, graceful.
